verdict.rationale: Terraform's docs say it manages cloud and on-prem resources on 'any cloud'. The public Registry lets anyone publish and consume providers, and authors can write their own. Community users confirm practical breadth: one calls cross-account AWS work trivial, another maintains a Kubernetes provider, and others call it the best tool for managing cloud infrastructure. Missing for 10: no named evidence of first-class providers for each major cloud (e.g., Azure, GCP), no explicit evidence of SaaS provider coverage, and no data on ecosystem size or provider count.
